#### ExecuteFetchXmlAllPagesAsync

```text
public System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryResult> ExecuteFetchXmlAllPagesAsync(System.String fetchXml, System.Int32 maxRecords = 5000, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Executes a FetchXML query with automatic paging, returning all results. Use with caution for large result sets.

- Parameter `fetchXml`: The FetchXML query to execute.
- Parameter `maxRecords`: Maximum total records to retrieve. Default is 5000.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Returns: The query result containing all records up to maxRecords.

#### ExecuteFetchXmlAsync

```text
public System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryResult> ExecuteFetchXmlAsync(System.String fetchXml, System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> pageNumber = default, System.String pagingCookie = default, System.Boolean includeCount = false, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Executes a FetchXML query and returns the results.

- Parameter `fetchXml`: The FetchXML query to execute.
- Parameter `pageNumber`: Optional page number for paging (1-based). If null, uses page 1.
- Parameter `pagingCookie`: Optional paging cookie from a previous query result for continuation.
- Parameter `includeCount`: Whether to include the total record count in the result.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Returns: The query result containing records, columns, and paging information.

#### ExecuteFetchXmlAsync

```text
public System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryResult> ExecuteFetchXmlAsync(System.String fetchXml, System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> pageNumber, System.String pagingCookie, System.Boolean includeCount, PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryExecutionOptions executionOptions, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Executes a FetchXML query with optional execution options (bypass plugins/flows). Default implementation ignores execution options and delegates to the base overload. Override in concrete classes to apply PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryExecutionOptions.


#### GetTotalRecordCountAsync

```text
public System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<System.Nullable`1<System.Int64>> GetTotalRecordCountAsync(System.String entityLogicalName, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Gets the total record count for an entity using RetrieveTotalRecordCountRequest. This is a near-instant metadata read, not a full table scan.

- Parameter `entityLogicalName`: The logical name of the entity to count.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Returns: The total count, or null if not supported for this entity.
